rubric.role_summary: Revenue Operations Manager owning Salesforce data, go-to-market systems, forecasting, reporting, and scalable revenue processes across Business Development, Operations, and Finance.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Revenue Operations Manager owning Salesforce data, go-to-market systems, forecasting, reporting, and scalable revenue processes across Business Development, Operations, and Finance.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 4+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, GTM Systems, or a closely related role.
- Hands-on Salesforce experience.
- Experience with SQL, Excel/Sheets, or BI tools.
- Experience owning or heavily supporting a forecasting cadence and pipeline reporting.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience in B2B SaaS or defense tech.
- Salesforce certification.
- Hands-on Salesforce experience in administration, reporting, and data model design.
- Analytical skills working with SQL, Excel/Sheets, and BI tools.
- Familiarity with the broader revenue tech stack, including marketing automation, sales engagement, CPQ, BI, and data warehouse tools.
- A track record of turning ambiguous problems into documented, scalable processes.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): New York metropolitan area. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Hybrid work is based in one of these areas.
